one_liner: SEO toolset (backlinks, keyword research, site audit, rank tracking) with a REST API (v3) for programmatic data access.

auth.evidence_quote: Create and manage your API keys

access.evidence_quote: Try API endpoints without an Enterprise plan
access.notes: API v3 is included from the Lite plan ($129/mo) up; Starter and the free tier get no API access, per search results (ahrefs.com/pricing not directly fetched). Some free test queries are available without a full API purchase.

api.notes: Official hosted MCP server exposes 100+ tools per search results (github.com/ahrefs/ahrefs-mcp-server), requires Lite plan or higher; not independently fetched.

verdict.rationale: API key auth with a well-documented REST API and official MCP server, but full API access requires a paid Lite-tier-or-above subscription.
